name: Yonz Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Yonz Technology Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of aluminum alloy structural components for photovoltaic (PV) systems. The firm offers a comprehensive range of products, including various types of PV frames, building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) solutions, solar aluminum alloy mounting brackets, and specialized solar roof tiles. Additionally, Yonz Technology engages in the distribution of other photovoltaic bracket components. These essential products are designed to be integral parts of photovoltaic modules. Headquartered in Changzhou, China, the company was established in 2016.
